positions.name: MonitoringRolloutDesign
positions.frame: How should a monitoring rollout be configured, in order and in reporting cadence, so that it catches the loss it was installed to prevent?
positions.why: Both statements read the rollout as a design question. src-1 sets the order of installation (pilot in bay two, chosen because it lost the most seedlings), which is a sequencing choice tied to where loss occurred. src-3 sets the reporting interval (fifteen minutes), justified by an evidential consequence: slower reporting misses the overnight humidity drop. Together they answer how the rollout should be shaped to catch the failure it targets. No tension is held between the two members.
